content.text:
Interesting. This is a PE32+ (x86-64) console executable with 19 sections. Many sections have odd names like /4, /19, /31, etc. — those are likely sections with names that reference the string table (long section names in COFF format use "/NNN" to reference the string table). This is common with MinGW/GCC compiled binaries.

Imports show:
- CreateRemoteThread, WriteProcessMemory, VirtualProtectEx — process injection APIs!
- GetProcAddress, GetModuleHandleA — dynamic API resolution
- VirtualQuery, VirtualProtect — memory manipulation

TLS callbacks present — possible anti-debug.

Let me look at strings and disassembly.
